newsitem.title: POLAND: Gec-Alsthom buys 60 pct of Polish Konstal.
newsitem.headline: Gec-Alsthom buys 60 pct of Polish Konstal.

text.p: French-British consortium Gec-Alsthom has bought a 60-percent stake in Polish rolling stock producer Konstal from 15 Polish National Investment Funds (NFIs), the firm managing NFI 10 said in a statement.
Fidea Management Sp z oo said that GEC-Alsthom bought 33 percent of shares in Konstal from NFI 10 and 27 percent from other 14 NFIs, but did not disclose the value of the transaction.
The state treasury holds a 25 percent stake in Konstal and employees have 15 percent of the shares.
The statement said Konstal planned to direct a new issue to Gec-Alsthom, but gave no details.
Konstal, based in Chorzow, south-western Poland, had a net loss of 3.2 million zlotys in the first six months of 1996.
